title: Reviewed teaching assets and authorized retrieval
goal: Find eligible teaching material for the actual learning problem.
rationale: Topic similarity alone does not establish teaching suitability or permission to reuse content.
scope: Initial concise draft; specification only, no implementation or acceptance claimed. Reviewed homework/speaking exercises and explanations; private transcripts remain learner evidence. Sources: PD-13/15/16/33; Architecture section 6. Ranking/index tuning is deferred.

depends_on.reason: Uses the authenticated tutor and learner-evidence ownership boundary.

requirement.title: Reviewed teaching assets and authorized retrieval
requirement.statement: Retrieve permissioned, reviewed material by target subskill/confusion, level and task needs, with source/version references. Apply access and license restrictions before ranking; never turn private transcripts into shared teaching assets or invent missing exercise references.

scenarios.given: Eligible reviewed material matches the target confusion and level.
scenarios.then: Candidates include suitable material and its source/version, rather than merely a preferred-topic match.
scenarios.verification: Future retrieval observation against a small reviewed fixture bank.

scenarios.given: The only apparent matches are unauthorized, unreviewed or unavailable.
scenarios.then: Those items are not returned as eligible; the content gap remains explicit.
scenarios.verification: Future retrieval eligibility and no-match cases.

tasks.description: Store reviewed asset versions and their ownership/license metadata.
Retrieve eligible candidates with provenance and explicit gaps.
